explanation: Two positive squared terms and one negative squared term equal to 1 identify a hyperboloid of one sheet. The negative term is -x^2, so its axis of symmetry is the x-axis.

answers.correct_value: A hyperboloid of one sheet whose axis of symmetry is the $x$-axis
answers.wrong_value: A hyperboloid of two sheets whose axis of symmetry is the $x$-axis
